guard_streams.authority: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology / Building Digital UK
guard_streams.write_limit: The collection is an index of awarded procurement contracts. It does not establish current orderability, completed network build or measured speed for a selected parcel.

facts.detail: The page summarises local and regional Project Gigabit contracts awarded to suppliers.
The collection was published on 26 September 2022.
The collection was last updated on 17 December 2025.
Project Gigabit is described as enabling hard-to-reach communities to access gigabit-capable broadband.
BDUK used market engagement to identify areas for government intervention.
The Northern Ireland contract was added in December 2025.
The Openreach framework agreement was added to the collection in September 2024.
North Yorkshire and Lincolnshire contracts were added in July 2024.
Cornwall contracts were added in January 2023.
The Cumbria contract was added in December 2022.

guard_streams.write_limit: Framework and call-off values are procurement scope. Premises remain subject to planning, market research and engineering change and cannot be treated as current selected-parcel serviceability.

facts.detail: The framework page was published on 13 August 2024.
The page was last updated on 2 March 2026.
The agreement is cross-regional and covers premises across Great Britain.
The framework predominantly targets rural hard-to-reach premises outside commercial rollout.
Eight call-off contracts had been awarded under the framework.
Call-off 1 is listed at £159.2 million for 51,820 premises.
Call-off 2 is listed at £137.2 million for 41,140 premises.
Call-off 3 is listed at £150.5 million for 65,120 premises.
Call-off 6 is listed at £175.5 million for 77,640 premises.
Call-off 8 for Cheshire is listed at £37.5 million for 18,460 premises.

guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit network build contract – Lincolnshire and East Riding of Yorkshire
guard_streams.write_limit: Awarded contract scope and anticipated build dates are procurement evidence subject to detailed planning and technical change, not current parcel orderability.

facts.detail: The contract page was published on 25 July 2024.
Quickline is the awarded supplier.
The contract targets around 72,000 premises.
The contract value is £118.9 million.
The scope is described as hard-to-reach premises.
Four councils are listed as collaborating with BDUK and the supplier.
The first premises were anticipated to gain access by the end of 2025.
Residents and businesses can request a service after the network is built.
The premises scope is subject to detailed planning and technical change.
Further premises detail is published through BDUK transparency data.
